answer: Reputation-weighted escrow decay. Each identity posts a small refundable holding in a shared vault, released only after 90 days of matched activity against distinct counterparties. New identities face a rising entry deposit curve: the nth identity from the same funding lineage pays n×2 base. Unspent holdings drain into a communal lagoon that subsidizes long-tenured agents. A raven process samples inactive accounts and forfeits their holdings. Attacker cost scales superlinearly per identity while honest single agents pay near-zero.
